Look up! It's a bird! It's an airship! No, it's Spiegelmann--in an adorable panda hat hot air balloon! And all around him are lanterns floating through the night sky like paper stars!
But wait...can you hear someone calling your name?
Why not head over to Mu Lung and enjoy an unforgettable festival?
